description:
Stockholm artist MIYNT has released brand new single "The Strangest Game," the lead track from her debut EP titled Ep no. 1 slated for a Sept 16, 2016 release via B3SCI Records. 

A swirling ballad showing MIYNT at her most earnest and vulnerable yet, MIYNT says of the track, "The strangest game is a lovesong. It’s about the first phase of falling in love, when the person that you’re falling for is still a mystery and everything you do with this person feels very exciting."

The track marks the first taste of MIYNT's bold return since the summer 2015 release of debut 7" single "Civil War" / "Nick Drake." Her signature blend of electronic pop and grunge has seen critical support from outlets such as The FADER, i-D, The Guardian, DIY, SPIN, The SundayTimes ('Hottest Track'), and Solange's Saint Heron blog, and the The Line of Best Fit coined her, "dangerously refreshing." 

The forthcoming debut EP was created alongside the production prowess of Daniel Nigro (Sky Ferreira, JR JR, Carly Rae Jepsen) and showcases a refined sonic development with rich instrumentation and complex laying revealing a sound astutely honed and sharper than ever. 

A multi-faceted visual and conceptual artist, MIYNT also drew the single artwork for each of the EP's tracks herself. 

Sink your teeth into "The Strangest Game" and look out for more to come from MIYNT's debut EP over the coming months. Pre-order the EP both digitally and as limited edition gatefold 10" vinyl.
